title: Adapter Create Action Permission Consistency

items.action: create an adapter from Adapter Management

migration.reason: The existing fair_crm.scraper.create permission is reused.

backend.reason: Existing scraper adapter create authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No server API contract changes; only the Adapter Management create action is aligned with existing authorization.

audit.reason: Existing adapter creation behavior is unchanged.

menu.reason: No navigation menu changes are introduced.

route_guard.reason: The /data-integration/adapters route still requires fair_crm.scraper.read; this change only gates the create mutation action.

notes: AdapterManagementPage previously rendered and invoked adapter creation for users who only had scraper read access, while the backend requires fair_crm.scraper.create. The create entry point now hides and fails closed without create permission.
